compounds.name: Ibogaine

lingeringEffects.note: QT effects can outlast acute experience; no fixed extra duration added to modeled parent/metabolite clearance.

sourceNotes.halfLife: [estimate] Mash et al. 2018 reports average blood half-lives 1.6-6 h in dependent patients; provisional range-of-means proxy for healthy single-dose terminal kinetics. Healthy uninhibited terminal estimate was not available in the retrieved Glue 2015 abstract. Do not read this as a healthy-adult observed min/max. Paroxetine-pretreated healthy subjects had 10.2 h (Glue 2015); pharmacological inhibition is not steady state or an early phase. Neither phase added. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5996271/ ; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25651476/
sourceNotes.metabolism: [checked] CYP2D6 O-demethylation produces noribogaine; NIG is downstream. No parent formedFrom links. Human dose-recovery fraction and phenotype formation multipliers not quantified from recovered primary sources. In-vitro >95% contribution to intrinsic O-demethylase clearance is NOT a human dose formation fraction. https://dmd.aspetjournals.org/article/S0090-9556%2824%2904019-4/fulltext
sourceNotes.relevance: [checked] Directly dosed active compound and human QT-relevant species; retained active. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25651476/ ; https://accp1.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/cpdd.254
sourceNotes.molecularWeight: [checked] PubChem free-base molecular weight 310.4 g/mol, not hydrochloride. https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Ibogaine
sourceNotes.cyp2d6: [checked] Obach et al. 1998 human microsomes and Glue et al. 2015 human paroxetine interaction confirm CYP2D6 substrate. Healthy inhibited half-life 10.2 h; active-moiety AUC about doubled, which is NOT a half-life multiplier. Genotype model: CL = 0.82 + 30.7 x activity score L/h (Knuijver 2024); clearance is not terminal half-life in a multicompartment model. No validated poor/intermediate/ultrarapid half-life map extracted; null. Perpetrator strength/type unassessed: substrate status is not inhibitor evidence. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25651476/ ; https://dmd.aspetjournals.org/article/S0090-9556%2824%2904019-4/fulltext ; https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/02698811241237873

Knuijver 2024 human concentration-QTc sigmoid model Emax 67.9 ms, EC50 0.195 micromolar (RSE 64.1%); not a linear effect per body mg or an individual threshold. weight/referenceAmountMg null. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26329675/ ; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3853361/ ; https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/02698811241237873
